title: Demo: Northstar QuickHeat two-slice toasters recalled
product_description: Northstar QuickHeat two-slice toaster, matte black, model QH-220.
hazard: A wiring defect can cause the exterior housing to overheat, posing a burn hazard.
remedy: Stop using the toaster and consult the official recall notice for next steps.

title: Demo: VoltTrail portable power banks recalled
product_description: VoltTrail 10,000 mAh USB-C portable power bank, model VT10-C.
hazard: The lithium-ion battery can overheat and ignite.
remedy: Stop charging or using the product and consult the official notice.

title: Demo: Meadow & Mill almond granola recall
product_description: Meadow & Mill Almond Morning Granola, 340 g pouch.
hazard: The package may contain undeclared peanuts.
remedy: Do not consume the product if you have a peanut allergy. Consult the official notice.

title: Demo: Hearthway tomato soup recall
product_description: Hearthway roasted tomato soup in 400 mL cartons.
hazard: Some cartons may not have been processed adequately and could spoil.
remedy: Do not consume affected cartons. Consult the official recall record.

title: Demo: CardioView home monitor correction
product_description: CardioView Home blood pressure monitor, model CV-H4.
hazard: A software error may display an incorrect stored reading.
remedy: Review the official correction notice and contact a healthcare professional with medical questions.

title: Demo: FlowSure infusion pump field action
product_description: FlowSure ambulatory infusion pump, model FS-8.
hazard: A damaged latch can interrupt delivery unexpectedly.
remedy: Follow the manufacturer's official field action and contact a healthcare professional.
